question: Which city will host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is the **Los Angles**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**2028 Summer Olympic Games

__
 
• The United States of America will host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games.
 
• The 2028 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XXXIV Olympiad, and commonly known as LA28, is a forthcoming international multi-sport event that is scheduled to take place from July 21 to August 6, 2028, in Los Angeles, California, United States.
 
• It will be the first Summer Games to be held in the US since the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, and the first Olympics in the US since the 2002 Winter Olympics in Salt Lake City, Utah. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points:__**

__
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics will take place in Paris, France from July 26 to Aug. 11. 
 
• According to the official website for the Paris Olympics, new sports that will be introduced during these games include breaking (also known as breakdancing) and sport climbing.
 
• The 2032 Summer Olympics will take place in Brisbane, Australia from July 23 to Aug. 8.
 
• Events will be hosted across Queensland, including the Gold Coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**Tokyo 2021 Olympics:

 
• The 2021 summer Olympics is an international sports event that will be held from 23 July to 8 August 2021, in the city of Tokyo, Japan.
 
• As the name suggests, this summer Olympics were originally intended to be held from 24 July to 9 August 2020, but due to the ongoing Covid-19 Pandemic, Tokyo 2020 Olympics was postponed.
